Open Issues: LDE Migration Phase 1-2 (#103, #104)

#103 [OPEN]: LDE Phase 1 - Configuration with Zod
- src/server/config.ts を Zod でリファクタ
- 手動の parseEnvNumber/parseEnvFloat を Zod スキーマに置換
- 宣言的バリデーション

#104 [OPEN]: LDE Phase 2 - Immutability and Zod in Scoring
- src/server/scoring.ts を Zod + immutability でリファクタ
- ScoringWeights, ScoringProfileName の Zod スキーマ
- readonly 修飾子の適用

参照: rules/law-driven-engineering.md
